amb13_text: You have recently joined a project team at work. amb3_text: You are at a dinner with a few friends. One of them asks for advice about someone new she has started seeing, and you, like the others, give her your advice. amb5_text: You are taking an evening class. Tonight, you and four other members of your group present a major group assignment; afterwards, you are going to celebrate with a beer.
